biography.plain_text: Gulbakhor Burkhanovna Ismailova is an Uzbek-born retired gynaecologist who spent her medical career in Tashkent. Her public financial profile is not linked to a documented business career, but to family trusts associated with her brother, industrialist Alisher Usmanov. Authorities identified her as a settlor and, historically, a beneficiary in structures connected to major assets including Dilbar; her representatives say she later irrevocably renounced any future benefit from those trusts.
